QuestInfo.name: Remembering to Forget
QuestInfo.0: You decide to heed the Grim Reaper's warning. Those who loved her in life, had spent years getting over Anna's death. Chief Stan was clearly one of those people, and it doesn't seem fair to make them relive that pain.
